title: Reverse without mutating
hints: A slice is a view onto a backing array. Swapping elements of the input slice also changes the caller's data.
make([]int, len(in)) allocates a fresh slice of the right length, and it's non-nil even when the length is 0.
Allocate out := make([]int, len(in)), then fill out[i] = in[len(in)-1-i] for every index i.
